headline: 13 contracts and wallets catalogued on Ethereum (and 2 BSC pools) from official docs; 4 operational Fireblocks 2-of-3 MPC wallets, 2 core token contracts (proxy), 2 price feeds, 4 liquidity pools, 1 mint/redeem, 1 withdraw contract; no GitHub repo or audit PDFs directly accessible.

findings.text: D1: Etherscan name-tag search via web_search surfaced 'Saturn: USDat Token' at 0x23238f20b894f29041f48d88ee91131c395aaa71 (proxy, implementation 0x17cAC25c...Eb4D1E52E), 'Staked USDat (sUSDat)' at 0xd166337499e176bbc38a1fbd113ab144e5bd2df7. A legacy 'Saturn Network' deployer 0x23cc32a2f2cf1477e7aa43774663f7f96e3b8f99 is a different 2020-era DEX protocol and excluded.

D2: Official 'Key Addresses' page at https://saturncredit.gitbook.io/saturn-docs/operations-and-governance/key-addresses.md lists 14 entries: 2 core token contracts, 1 mint/redeem, 1 withdraw, 2 price feeds, 2 Ethereum Curve pools, 2 BSC PancakeSwap pools, and 4 Fireblocks 2-of-3 MPC operational wallets (Admin, Compliance, Processor, Processor/Asset Cap Manager). Deployed_contracts_doc set to this URL.

D3: Transparency & Audits page at https://saturncredit.gitbook.io/saturn-docs/operations-and-governance/transparency-and-audits.md references 4 audit file attachments (GitBook internal file IDs, not public URLs). A CoinGecko article (fetched via search) states 'smart contracts audited by Three Sigma and Certora'. Audit PDFs are not directly fetchable; URLs not available; firms and approximate date recorded from secondary source. Addresses from audit scope not extractable.

D4: protocol.github is recorded as '(none recorded)' in the per-protocol context. The app website and docs do not link a GitHub organization. No deployment artifacts, broadcast JSONs, or hardhat-deploy files discoverable. GitHub discovery failed.

D5: Protocol.chains lists only Ethereum. However, docs reveal 2 BSC (BNB Chain) PancakeSwap pools: USDT<>USDat at 0xF80Ab3Cc041d8Ccc1c51AcC295AFdba26AD70Aa9 and USDT<>sUSDat at 0xf3396a9a79257D89f98143d8AB73da1dFF4e0e81. These are liquidity pool addresses (not core protocol), on BNB Chain (chainId=56), and are catalogued as role=pool. No block-explorer name-tag search was performed on BSC for these addresses (only sourced from docs).
D6: No factory contract identified in docs or explorer results. The protocol deploys fixed token contracts rather than using a factory pattern. No factory enumeration needed.

D7: Role taxonomy applied: USDat=token (proxy), sUSDat=token (proxy), Mint/Redeem=other, Withdraw=other, Saturn STRC Price Feed=oracle, Chainlink STRC Price Feed=oracle, 2 Ethereum Curve pools=pool, 2 BSC Pancake pools=pool, Admin wallet=admin (multisig), Compliance wallet=multisig, Processor wallet=multisig, Processor/Asset Cap Manager wallet=multisig. All 4 operational wallets: actor_class=multisig (Fireblocks 2-of-3 MPC per docs).

D8: All addresses in admin_addresses[] trace to the fetched Key Addresses page (https://saturncredit.gitbook.io/saturn-docs/operations-and-governance/key-addresses.md). The USDat proxy address also confirmed via Etherscan search snippet. No addresses sourced from snippet-only or unfetched pages.

rationale.verdict: Walked saturn.credit app, saturncredit.gitbook.io docs (including Key Addresses and Transparency pages), and Etherscan name-tag search; catalogued 13 unique Ethereum addresses plus 2 BSC pool addresses = 15 total. No GitHub repo is publicly linked. Audit firms (Three Sigma, Certora) identified from secondary source but PDFs not directly accessible. Grade=unknown because discovery slice always returns unknown.

protocol_metadata.about: Saturn is a dual-token stablecoin protocol on Ethereum where users deposit USDC to mint USDat, a non-yielding stablecoin backed 1:1 by tokenized U.S. Treasuries via M0's $M token. Users who stake USDat receive sUSDat, an ERC-4626 yield-bearing vault token that converts the underlying Treasury collateral into STRC (Strategy's preferred equity instrument paying Bitcoin-backed dividends), accruing yield as STRC dividends vest. The system is permissioned for minting/redemption (whitelisted users via approved custodians) and features a 3–7 day withdrawal queue for sUSDat redemptions.
